scope: XGComputeTexture3DLayout (ordinal 6), XGCreateTexture3DComputer (ordinal 10) and generic XGCreateTextureComputer (ordinal 11) for a bounded 3D subset. Identical guest and XMem dependency; complete layouts and sampled element addresses compared against the supplied Xbox XG DLL.
subset: 57 uncompressed color formats; eight rectangular shapes with widths 65, 68, 128 or 129 and heights 13 or 37; depth 1, 8 or 17; two or three mips; shader-resource bind; 4 KiB swizzle with default or immutable usage; no packed tails; no CPU access flags, misc flags or explicit pitch. Depth-only mip chains, block-compressed formats and other combinations are unsupported.
checks: all three exports and complete matching layouts
sampled mip and depth-slice addresses including the first out-of-range slice
